summary: Dixie Peak lookout cab in Kaniksu NF: gabled L-4 on rock piers, built 1931, removed 1955; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Gabled L-4 cab atop rock piers
facts.status_note: Removed in 1955 per two sources. No source describes what, if anything, remains.

events.note: Gabled L-4 cab built in 1931. In October 1931 construction was under way at Dixie Peak with John Larson in charge.

evidence.supports: gabled L-4 cab atop rock piers, built in 1931, removed in 1955
evidence.quote: This gabled L-4 cab atop rock piers, built in 1931, was removed in 1955.

evidence.supports: gabled L-4 cab on piers, built 1931, removed 1955
evidence.quote: A gabled L-4 cab atop rick piers built in 1931, removed in 1955.

evidence.supports: location 16 miles west-northwest of Thompson Falls
Kaniksu National Forest administers the site
October 1931 construction at Dixie Peak with John Larson in charge
evidence.quote: at Dixie Peak with John Larson in charge.

evidence.supports: lookout houses being constructed in 1931, quoted from the Sanders County Independent-Ledger
evidence.quote: Lookout houses are now being constructed at Lookout Peak by Charles Nelson and Leslie Anderson

evidence.supports: Lookout houses also going up at Border Peak in the same 1931 item
evidence.quote: at Border Peak by Bob Paulin and Jim Carter

evidence.supports: survey location 22N-32W-15 given on the Forest Lookouts page
Forest Lookouts page marks the site removed
Forest Fire Lookout Association lists Dixie Peak as a gone ground lookout in Sanders County

notes_for_editor: Brief kind 'ground' kept: FFLOS's 'Ground' fits a cab on piers with no tower. The Sanders County Ledger text reads 'rick piers', most likely a typo for 'rock', so it is not quoted in the story. No staffing, fire or current-site information in the sources read. No access source. Photo credit on firelookout.com (Fire Lookout Museum) has no image URL in the cache, so no photo record was added.
